label: neiso 22 ccsteam keeper
definition: neiso 22 (KEEPER — supersedes neiso 21). Re-ran the monthly-keeper config (--commitment --ct-deployment --hydro-backfill-year 2024 --hydro-eia930-monthly) to integrate the combined-cycle steam-turbine unit-outage derate (eia_*_cc capacity coupling in campd-unit-outages-NEISO.csv; derivation-script level, NO magic numbers — the fitted daily-AGT convexity stays rejected), and fixed a poisoned gas-basis cell. VERDICT: NEISO is backcast-calibrated. CC_REGULAR 52.30/56.51/57.76 reproduces the keeper (52.31/56.48/57.75) within +/-0.03 TWh; gas within ~1% of EIA-930 all years (54.76/58.87/60.11 vs 55.47/59.64/60.09); LW hub $35.08/$40.52/$71.20 vs actual DA $36.82/$41.47/$67.86 (-4.7/-2.3/+4.9%); the 2025 monthly DA shape tracks actual within a few $/MWh every month. The CC-steam derate is a NEAR-NO-OP for NEISO — controlled A/B (only the outage CSV swapped) moves 2025 CC_REGULAR -0.02 TWh and LW price +$0.9; the fleet has the headroom to absorb it (adopt for cross-ISO consistency). SEPARATELY FIXED (commit aa62655): the 15:46 fetch-eia-gas-prices refresh (postdates neiso 21) wrote a +$13.46/MMBtu Aug-2025 AGT basis from the EIA MA citygate proxy — a winter-level summer-month LDC citygate average that drove modeled Aug-2025 LMP to $167 vs the actual $45.6 DA; replaced with the Jul/Sep interpolation (+0.04). Before a forecast run: the neighbor-convexity priced-import node is REQUIRED (the seam is a fixed measured schedule today), plus the derived daily-AGT winter-oil convexity when upload U4 lands (oil 0.00/0.00/0.06 vs EIA-930 0.32/0.37/1.24, LMP-neutral). Full diagnosis: results/calibration/DIAGNOSIS-neiso-ccsteam-2026-06-19.md; forecast-prep prompts: docs/multi-iso/neiso-forecast-prep-prompts.md. SYSTEM VOLUME ERROR FIX (render_calibration_html, incomplete-vintage benchmark repair): the 2025 fossil benchmark was raw preliminary EIA-923, under-counting CC by ~4 TWh (CC bench 53.12 vs model 57.76, which matches complete EIA-930 within 1%), inflating the 2025 system volume error to +7.25%. The benchmark now scales any fossil fuel whose grid 923 total is <0.97x the complete EIA-930 grid series up to that EIA-930 total (split/shape preserved); 2025 sys vol err +7.25% -> ~0%, complete vintages (2023 1.02x / 2024 1.02x) untouched. CEMS audit confirmed CEMS under-reads CC every year (44-49 vs 923's 52-57) so it is a shape source, not a level authority; the model is correct.
